sources.entry: FlyCrys by Sergii Kamenskyi - A native Linux GUI for Claude Code agents built in Rust + GTK4 — single binary, no Electron, starts in under a second — with a file tree, syntax-highlighted viewer, markdown preview, embedded VTE4 terminal, streaming agent chat, workspace tabs, and tool-restricted agent profiles. Fills a real gap as essentially the only native (non-webview) Linux desktop client, using

summary.one_liner: FlyCrys is a native Linux GTK4 desktop GUI for Claude Code agents, with a file tree, text viewer, embedded terminal and streaming agent chat, written in Rust and not built on Electron.
summary.what_it_does: FlyCrys provides a GTK4 window that wraps the Claude Code CLI, arranged as a file tree on the left, a text viewer in the middle, agent chat on the right and a terminal panel at the bottom. The file tree lazy-loads, refreshes via an inotify watcher, shows git status coloring and includes a project-wide search. The viewer offers Source, Preview and Diff modes, syntax highlighting for about 50 languages, an in-view find bar and image preview; markdown preview is rendered in WebKitGTK. The run panel holds multiple shell tabs backed by VTE4 and auto-creates tabs for background tasks Claude starts. The agent chat streams markdown responses, shows tool calls inline, answers AskUserQuestion prompts as cards, supports session resume, image attachments and agent profiles with custom system prompts and tool restrictions. Each project gets a workspace tab, and sessions, window layout and open files are persisted. The README states the app is not an IDE and does not edit files itself; agents do that.
use_cases: Chat with Claude Code agents from a native Linux desktop
Browse a project's files while an agent works
Preview markdown and images next to agent output
Run multiple project workspaces side by side
Restrict an agent to a limited set of tools via profiles
Review git diffs and changes made by an agent
how_to_run: sudo apt install libgtk-4-dev libvte-2.91-gtk4-dev libwebkitgtk-6.0-dev libjavascriptcoregtk-6.0-dev libsoup-3.0-dev
git clone <URL missing in README> && cd FlyCrys
notable: Native GTK4 app with no Electron or webview shell for the main UI, shipped as a single binary
Agent profiles (Security, Research, Default) with custom system prompts and tool restrictions
Clone workspace action forks the agent's Claude session using --fork-session
Background task tabs stream output from Claude's run_in_background commands
Development has stopped: the README says Anthropic released an official Claude Desktop app for Linux and recommends using it
caveats: No longer actively developed: no new features, bug fixes or support; the code still builds and the last release still works
Requires the Claude Code CLI installed separately via npm
Linux only, requires GTK4, VTE4, WebKitGTK 6.0 and libsoup 3.0 system libraries
The README's install examples are missing their URLs (curl and git clone targets are blank)
